# gcp-billing-analyzer

> Analyze Google Cloud billing exports in newline-delimited JSON: gross, credits and net cost by project, service, SKU, region or label with exact Decimal sums Python package `trysac-gcp-billing-analyzer`, import name `gcp_billing_analyzer`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
